entries.good_example:
log_event() { local level=$1 msg=$2; echo "[$(date +'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z')] [${level}] ${msg}" >&2; }
log_event "ERROR" "Failed to connect to DB"
entries.rationale: Unstructured logs are useless for automated parsing. SS QLM enforces ISO 8601 timestamps and explicit log levels (INFO, WARN, ERROR, DEBUG) redirected to stderr.
Scripts should be quiet by default for cron jobs but provide deep visibility when needed. SS QLM requires a VERBOSE flag for non-critical output.
